selection_rule: five latest published non-prerelease GitHub releases per selected dependency within declared package major ranges; four adjacent chronological release transitions; no code or outcome inspection
limitations: Historical publicly available source, held out from builders within this study; not prospective releases or secret data.
Model pretraining or prior general knowledge may include these histories.
Dependency declaration is evidence of project relevance, not current upgrade permission or proof a lock change is safe.
Per-package .py snapshots exclude tests/fixtures and do not establish dynamic behavior, semantic compatibility or deployment acceptance.
